items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 Simply one of the best games I've ever d
items.summary: Simply one of the best games I've ever downloaded. Character design, story, overall art, and ost along with the sfx is just wonderful godd, plus it's F2P friendly. Though there's 1 problem, lack in translator, so translation are done majority by ai (I'm not accusing them, they clearly stated that they use ai), which came out pretty weird, grammar errors here and there and bunch of jumbled word, you could still understand it so it's not that big of a deal. Peak games overall, recommended.
items.author: Naditya K

items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 It pains me to not be able to wholeheart
items.summary: It pains me to not be able to wholeheartedly recommend Morimens anymore. They have been driving the game to a more p2w direction for months then hit their peak anti-consumer change with the most recent update. Devs killed player agency and team diversity in a single braindead patch that brought 5 to 10x number to the main endgame content which turned most units obsolete overnight. How they have been handling the aftermath has been nothing but disappointment.
